acceptance_criteria: fetchParents expansion implemented. No duplicate ancestors. Tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented fetchParents ancestor expansion in handle_filenode_get; calls get_ancestors, deduplicates; +2 tests; 19 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Replace the one-liner handle_filenode_get with a real implementation that handles fetchParents. Oracle: §3.2.1.

**Algorithm:**
1. Extract fetch_parents: bool from args (default false).
2. Call generic handle_get as before → (mut resp, sub_calls).
3. If fetch_parents:
   a. Parse the list array from resp to extract returned node ids.
   b. Call backend.get_ancestors(&account_id, &collected_ids).
   c. Filter out ancestors already in the list (dedup).
   d. Serialize remaining ancestors and append to resp list array.
4. Return modified (resp, sub_calls).
5. Update MockBackend: add set_ancestor(node_id, ancestor_node) helper.

**Tests:**
- fetchParents=false → response identical to before (regression).
- fetchParents=true with top-level node → list unchanged (no parent).
- fetchParents=true with one parent → parent appended exactly once.
- fetchParents=true with two nodes sharing same parent → parent appears exactly once (no dup). Oracle: §3.2.1 ancestor nodes not duplicated.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 4 tests pass. cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server exits 0.
title: Implement fetchParents ancestor expansion in FileNode/get
